      private Result(PidDesignModel restoredModel, PidSimulationBindings restoredBindings, Dexpi201DynamicBindingReader.Result nativeEvidence, DexpiXmlReader.ImportResult supportedImport, List<String> intakeDiagnostics, String manifestSha256)
      Captures verified package content and semantic evidence.
      Parameters:
      restoredModel - restored canonical P&ID model
      restoredBindings - verified executable bindings
      nativeEvidence - native DEXPI relationship evidence
      supportedImport - supported-subset import and diagnostics
      intakeDiagnostics - ordered package-level semantic diagnostics
      manifestSha256 - exact package-manifest fingerprint
